Children with fewer than 2 prior doses need 2 doses, but that part is not encoded.","denominator":"{\"age\": {\"min\": 1, \"max\": 8, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"Age 6 months–8 years\", \"derived\": {\"min\": \"minimum age is 6 months, which cannot be expressed in whole years; age >=1 at year end is used so every included child was eligible during the year (infants 6-11 months are omitted)\"}}","numerator":"{\"immunization\": {\"concept\": \"influenza_vaccine\", \"min_count\": 1, \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"annually\", \"derived\": {\"min_count\": \"every child in this age band needs at least 1 dose per year (1 or 2 depending on prior history), so 1 is the minimum expected count\"}}","exclusions":"[]"},{"id":"FLU-ANNUAL-9-18","version":"2025","title":"Annual influenza vaccination, age 9-18 years (1 dose)","source_quote":"Use any influenza vaccine appropriate for age and health \nstatus annually:","grade":"ACIP routine recommendation","effective_date":"2025","action":"Administer one age-appropriate influenza vaccine dose each year.","denominator":"{\"age\": {\"min\": 9, \"max\": 18, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"Age 9 years or older: 1 dose\", \"derived\": {\"max\": \"this is the child/adolescent schedule, which covers ages through 18 years; adults are handled by the adult schedule\"}}","numerator":"{\"immunization\": {\"concept\": \"influenza_vaccine\", \"min_count\": 1, \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"Age 9 years or older: 1 dose\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["The 2-dose requirement is not encoded. It applies to children aged 6 months-8 years who received fewer than 2 influenza doses before July 1, 2024, or whose history is unknown; the doses must be separated by at least 4 weeks, and dose 2 is given even if the child turns 9 between doses. FLU-ANNUAL-1-8 checks only for at least 1 dose.","Infants aged 6-11 months are eligible but are not captured by the whole-year age floor (min 1 at year end) in FLU-ANNUAL-1-8.","Influenza vaccination is season-based (roughly July-June), but the rules use a calendar measurement-year window. This approximates the season and may misattribute doses given late in one season or early in the next.","Product choice and minimum ages per product are not encoded: IIV3 from 6 months, LAIV3 from 2 years, RIV3 from 18 years.","Not encoded: HD-IIV3 and aIIV3 are acceptable options for 18-year-old solid organ transplant recipients on immunosuppressive medications.","Season-specific guidance by external reference (2024-25 MMWR, 2025-26 ACIP recommendations) is not encoded.","The LAIV3 contraindication is not encoded. Close contacts of severely immunosuppressed persons needing a protected environment should not receive LAIV3, and if they do, should avoid contact with such persons for 7 days. This depends on household contact information, which is not computable.","Not encoded: persons with egg allergy may receive any age-appropriate influenza vaccine. This is informational and has no exclusion effect.","General contraindications and precautions to influenza vaccination are not stated in this section; no exclusions are encoded."]}
